query: NVIDIA fiscal year end and fiscal quarter end dates
normalized: dates end fiscal nvidia quarter year

output.content:
NVIDIA uses a **52/53-week fiscal year ending on the last Sunday in January**; FY2026 ended **January 25, 2026**, while FY2027 is a 53-week year and will also end on the last Sunday in January. [[1, 2]] 

Its fiscal quarters generally end on the last Sundays of **April (Q1), July (Q2), October (Q3), and January (Q4)**, with quarters normally 13 weeks (and a 14-week Q4 in a 53-week year). [[3, 1]] 

For example, in FY2026 the reported quarter-end dates were: **Q1: April 27, 2025; Q2: July 27, 2025; Q3: October 26, 2025; and Q4/FY-end: January 25, 2026.** [[4, 5, 2]]
